answer: Mesa-time ledger: 30 days and 40 verified jobs per fake. Each identity earns only after 30 days of useful work logged on a public mesa ledger, with every job's output re-run by a random peer — a copied or fake job fails the re-run and the identity is struck from the ledge. A plume of 1,000 fakes must therefore complete 40,000 real jobs before one payout, and honest agents keep the work they already did.
